subject: Initial mutual-playbook: goals, stakeholders, and timeline (Novamed)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priayom@redwood.in>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@novamed.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.in>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.in>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial mutual-playbook: goals, stakeholders, and timeline (Novamed)

Oliver —

Great to meet you last week. As discussed, I’m sending an initial mutual playbook to align on goals, owners, and a realistic close timeline. The objective here is to create a short, actionable MAP so we can run a focused evaluation and make a purchase decision by the end of May (customer target).

High-level proposed goals (please confirm or edit):
- 2-week technical evaluation (integration + perf smoke tests)
- Business validation: search/ summarization workflows on a 5k-record dataset
- Pass security checklist (SOC 2 evidence & network tests)
- Sign PO for Dedicated capacity if evaluation meets SLAs

Proposed timeline (draft):
- Week 1 (Apr 5–11): Kickoff, access & infra prep, SAML test account
- Week 2 (Apr 12–18): Demo for infra + perf runs; collect logs/metrics
- Week 3 (Apr 19–25): Business QA & user feedback; iterate prompts
- Week 4 (Apr 26–30): Final review, commercial terms, procurement prep

Attachments: novamed_map_draft_v1.pdf (MAP draft), redwood_trial_plan.xlsx (trial checklist + test cases).

Primary ask from you: confirm the champion (you), confirm internal stakeholders who will be part of the evaluation (tech, security, procurement), and any date constraints we should honor. Once you confirm, we’ll set a 30–45 minute kickoff next week and assign owners.

Diego — I’ve cc’d you for technical readiness and an intro demo slot. Marissa — looping you for success coordination and post-trial adoption plan.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priayom@redwood.in | +1 415-555-0198

[Attachment: novamed_map_draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 210 KB)]
[Attachment: redwood_trial_plan.xlsx (XLSX, 85 KB)]

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@novamed.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priayom@redwood.in>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novamed.ai>, Lina Wu <lina.wu@novamed.ai>, Purchasing Team <procurement@novamed.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.in>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.in>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial mutual-playbook: goals, stakeholders, and timeline (Novamed)

Priyom — thanks for this. High level looks good and aligns with our internal thinking. Two quick notes from my side:

1) Timeline: our internal goal is to finish vendor selection by the last week of May, but procurement reviews typically take 10 business days after final terms are agreed. If possible, can we aim to wrap commercial negotiations by May 20 so we have buffer for PO?

2) Stakeholders: adding Samir Patel (CTO) for infra review and Lina Wu (Head of Procurement) for contracting. Lina asked that we include procurement@novamed.ai on any contract/PO threads. Also looping in our security lead (cc'd privately if needed).

Security asks: please include SOC 2 Type II report or the audit scope & evidence path. Also any data residency notes for logs. If you can surface those in the kickoff, that would save time.

I’m happy to be the primary champion. Let’s schedule a 30-minute kickoff on Tue Apr 6 or Wed Apr 7 afternoon PT — I’m flexible after 1pm.

Thanks,
Oliver
Senior Product Manager, Novamed
oliver@novamed.ai | ext. 241

Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial mutual-playbook: goals, stakeholders, and timeline (Novamed)

Thanks Oliver, Priyom — welcome Samir and Lina. Quick technical notes from my side:

- We can provide a sandbox VPC and a short-lived S3 test account for ingest. For perf: can you confirm typical sequence lengths and avg tokens per request? That will help us size the trial machines.
- For SOC2/questions: I’ll attach the redwood_security_pack in the kickoff folder (SOC2 summary, encryption details, data retention defaults). If Lina wants the full report we can provide an auditor cover letter and an NDA if required.
- Suggested demo run: 45 minutes (15m infra, 20m live inference on sample dataset, 10m Q&A). We should have Samir or their infra lead on the call.

Availability: Wed Apr 7 1:30–3:30pm PT works for a demo slot.

Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.in

Thanks all — great momentum. Confirming the plan and next steps: 

1) Kickoff + demo: Wed Apr 7, 1:30pm PT — 45 minutes (calendar invite to follow). Diego will run the demo; Samir/infra team invited for perf conversation.
2) Security pack: Diego will upload SOC2 summary and encryption notes to the shared folder before kickoff. If Lina needs the full report, we can route via your procurement NDA process.
3) Trial access: Redwood will provision sandbox VPC + S3 access by Apr 8. Marissa will send a short checklist for the eval owners.
4) Commercial timing: we’ll aim to finish commercial terms by May 20 to give procurement room for PO approval as requested.

Action items assigned:
- Priyom: send calendar invite + MAP v1 (updated with confirmed owners) — TODAY
- Diego: upload security pack + prepare demo environment — by Wed Apr 7 10am PT
- Marissa: share evaluation checklist and success criteria doc — by Apr 8
- Oliver: confirm any blackout dates for procurement review in May

Links: HubSpot deal RDW-2027-0134 (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/RDW-2027-0134) and MAP doc (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c4d-novamed-map).

If that looks good I’ll update the MAP and distribute the invite. Thanks again for moving quickly on this — excited to partner.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priayom@redwood.in | +1 415-555-0198
